test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Shifa can do a certain piece of work in 28 days. Shifa and Afiya can together do the same work in 20 days, and Shifa, Afiya and Mariyam can do the same work together in 10 days. In how many days can Shifa and Mariyam do the same work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Shifa alone = 28 days

Shifa + Afiya = 20 days

Shifa + Afiya + Mariyam = 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

Total rate of two or more persons = Sum of individual rates

**Calculation:**

⇒ Shifa's rate = 1 ÷ 28

⇒ (Shifa + Afiya) rate = 1 ÷ 20

⇒ Afiya's rate = (1 ÷ 20) − (1 ÷ 28)

⇒ Afiya's rate = (7 − 5) ÷ 140

⇒ Afiya's rate = 2 ÷ 140

⇒ Afiya's rate = 1 ÷ 70

⇒ (Shifa + Afiya + Mariyam) rate = 1 ÷ 10

⇒ Mariyam's rate = (1 ÷ 10) − [(1 ÷ 28) + (1 ÷ 70)]

⇒ (1 ÷ 28) + (1 ÷ 70) = (5 ÷ 140) + (2 ÷ 140)

⇒ (1 ÷ 28 + 1 ÷ 70) = 7 ÷ 140

⇒ = 1 ÷ 20

⇒ Mariyam's rate = (1 ÷ 10) − (1 ÷ 20)

⇒ Mariyam's rate = (2 ÷ 20) − (1 ÷ 20)

⇒ Mariyam's rate = 1 ÷ 20

⇒ (Shifa + Mariyam) rate = (1 ÷ 28) + (1 ÷ 20)

⇒ = (5 ÷ 140) + (7 ÷ 140)

⇒ = 12 ÷ 140

⇒ = 6 ÷ 70

⇒ = 3 ÷ 35

⇒ Time = 35 ÷ 3

**∴ The correct answer is (35)/(3) days.**
